sourceReview.reason: CoinDesk's full report says Securitize announced Stellar support at Meridian 2026, but neither Securitize nor Stellar has published an accessible primary release or technical documentation, and no second independent full-text report was found. The report names no live product, deployment address, launch timetable or transaction, so the new integration cannot yet be documented to the required standard.
